title: Additional corrupted Buildings + Units
author: habus
description:
a submod to give some additional buildings and units to corrupted Miao and Katarina

READ THIS FIRST TO KNOW WHAT TO ACTIVATE!

This mod is modular so you can activate what you want from it.

tdw_corrupted_buildings.pack is the base and therefore required

-
Requires @Soil_Miaoying_Corrupted_Units.pack

-
the tdw_corrupted_buildings_alt.pack - is the same, just without the soil mod required (units got replaced with vanilla units) - only use one of them

-
also requires Mixu's Unlocker (available via steam workshop: <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859968660> )

-

and ofc requires Lazy's Corrupted Miao Ying Progression and Lazy's Corrupted Katarin

-

adds a bunch of buildings locked behind Miao Yings (or Katarins) corruption Stage (see Spoiler below for details)

-

also allows to recruit some vanilla units from norsca, beastmen and chaos at specific building

The unit mods are optional - so choose what you want and if specifically mentioned that the original pack is required, you have to have it active

-
tdw_corrupted_buildings_add_endos_kislev.pack:

-
adds endos Kislev reskined units as seperate units for corrupted Miao and corrupted Katarin.

-
tdw_corrupted_buildings_add_wef:

-
adds some of MachineofCat’s Forest of Debauchery units to corrupted Miao.

-
!tdw_corrupted_buildings_add_fem_berserker.pack:

-
adds Taraanis Kislev female berserkers for corrupted Miao.

-
requires: <https://www.nexusmods.com/totalwarwarhammer3/mods/179>

-
!tdw_corrupted_buildings_add_Amazon_Warrior.pack:

-
adds Taraanis Amazon Warrior for corrupted Miao.

-
requires: <https://www.nexusmods.com/totalwarwarhammer3/mods/185>

-
tdw_corrupted_buildings_add_slaangor.pack:

-
adds a custom hero based on Um's Slaanesh Beast Expand as well as the units for corrupted Miao.

-
requires: <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3321253105>

-
tdw_corrupted_buildings_add_slaanesh_zealots.pack:

-
adds JFred's Zealots of Slaanesh for corrupted Miao.

-
requires: <https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2858576975>

-
tdw_corrupted_buildings_add_wos.pack:

-
adds dbswlgn3786's (DOVAKIN) Warrior of Slaanesh reskin as seperate units for corrupted Miao and corrupted Katarin.

-
Don't use together with tdw_corrupted_buildings_add_wos_vanilla.pack

-
tdw_corrupted_buildings_add_wos_vanilla.pack:

-
submod to add vanilla Warrior of Slaanesh units for corrupted Miao.

-
Don't use together with tdw_corrupted_buildings_add_wos.pack

-
tdw_corrupted_buildings_slaver.pack:

-
submod to add a building based slave mechanic for miao and kat

Soontm :

-
will add some more soon (have to wait for permission and need to clean the files up)

-
better description page + some pics (There will come a day when I will do that <https://i.imgur.com/pG7U8Q9.jpeg>)

Some more details on what buildings are added:

[[SPOILER]]

-
7 landmarks in woodelf areas ( 1 with a second level to it)

-
1 general building chain (4 buildinglevels) for general woodelf cities (so the tree settlements)

-
replacement for the defence buildings (so 2 buildingchains with 3 lvls each) for kislev and cathay, for major cities aswell as minors - and as cathay you get also access to the kislev ones in kislev lands (but only in kislev)

-
in total 5 building chains mirroring the vanilla kislev recruitment buildings for kislev (again available also for cathay in kislev lands)

-
1 building chain (3 levels) for norscan recruitment available in all northern chaos waste settlements (and only there)

-
2 buildingchains (one for major cities and one for minors) as replacement for the marketchain in kislev (again also for cathay in kislevlands)

-
1 buildingchain (with 4 levels) for all northern chaoswaste main settlements

-
1 buildingchain (with 3 levels) for the 3 bastions

-
3 buildingchains (with 2 levels) for beastmen recruitment on specific settlements (village of the moon in cathay, quelness in bretonia and forrest of arnheim in naggaroth)

-
3 buildings (1 level) for skinwolves around kislev (igerov, tower of khrakk and altar of spwans) for cathay and katarin

-
1 Buildingchain (7 levels) for a slaaneshi temple Building for cathay

all building icons (not anymore all)
